ITEM 1 | Spinach leaves: dark green, flat and glossy-edged, scattered across the bowl bottom and sides, some folded, covering roughly 35% of bowl area, thin layer about 0.5 cm | 45
ITEM 2 | Avocado slices: pale green flesh with darker green skin edges, smooth and slightly glossy, cut into wedge-shaped slices about 5-7 cm long and 1.5 cm thick, roughly 10 slices clustered on the right and center, covering about 20% of bowl area | 120
ITEM 3 | Diced cooked chicken: off-white to light tan cubes about 1.5-2 cm, some edges browned and slightly golden, firm and dry-looking, scattered over the top across about 25% of bowl area, roughly 1.5 cm high | 110
ITEM 4 | Dark red kidney beans or similar dark legumes: deep burgundy-brown, smooth, rounded, about 1.5 cm across, scattered among the greens and chicken, about 8 pieces | 35
ITEM 5 | Crispy browned bits: small golden-brown pieces with darker char-like edges and slightly crumbly texture, scattered among chicken cubes, about 6 pieces of about 1 cm | 10
